{{Quote|Make way, make way for your new master, the master of Biitu, the Great Heep!''"<br />"''Who?''"<br />"''Heep!|The announcer droid and C-3PO|<ref name="TGH" />}}
A hovering '''announcer droid''' announced the arrival of the<ref name="TGH" /> [[Abominor]]<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[Great Heep]] to several [[Droid/Legends|droids]] captured by his forces on [[Biitu]],<ref name="TGH" /> an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]],<ref name="GEO">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].<ref name="15BBY">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} states that [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] is set fifteen years before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> After one of the captured droids, the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], inquired the name of his new master, the announcer droid used its loudspeakers to loudly repeat "Heep." The droid had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] and two [[Speaker/Legends|loudspeakers]] attached to its black-and-grey spherical body by orange connectors.<ref name="TGH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The announcer appeared in "[[The Great Heep]],"<ref name="TGH" /> a television special of the animated series [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']], which was first broadcast on [[June 7]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider32">{{InsiderCite|32|Caravan of Courage: Star Wars on Television|''Caravan of Courage'': ''Star Wars'' on Television}}</ref>
